reserveReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26088256 on 2026-09-30, asset() on the tracked sYUSD vault 0xfe0ccc9942e98c963fe6b4e5194eb6e3baa4cb64 returned tracked YUSD 0x4274cd7277c7bb0806bd5fe84b9adae466a8da0a and cooldownDuration() returned 604800 seconds. This independently confirms the exact wrapper parent and seven-day redemption cooldown. Reward accrual changes the exchange rate rather than the backing identity.
